method: own-MSL compile (shdump_dec_e5ad) -> agxparse --extract-hex -> bytediff.py -> scratch isadb.py; validated by roundtrip_test.py suite + whole-corpus asm(disasm(b))==b. NO hardware dispatch (compile+extract+tokenize+byte-diff only). No Apple binary inspected; only our own compiled shaders.

lengthRules.applyWhen: byte0 low-nibble==9 (float ALU), fma/3-source branch (byte+2 bit1 set), NOT a coord/special sub-form; length = 6 + 2*(byte+4 & 0x3)
lengthRules.lengthBitNote: ROOT-CAUSE FIX for the bogus 0x1e/0x2e/0x3e byte0 'gaps'. The compact VECTOR-CONTINUATION fma (2nd..Nth component of a floatN fma, byte+4==0x80 -> low2=0) is 6 bytes, not 8. The old `(6+2*(b4&3)) if (b4&3) else 8` over-read every continuation by 2 and exposed the next component's byte+2 op-select (0x1e/0x2e/0x3e) as a spurious leader. Use the SAME uniform 6+2*(byte+4&3) as the 2-source branch. own-shader t_fma4 (== corpus float_arith__fma_v4) reproduces it byte-exact; after the fix fma_v4 tokenizes to 0 leftover.

lengthRules.applyWhen: byte0 low-nibble==0xc AND byte+1 not in {0x0c,0xea} AND (byte+3 low-nibble)!=6 AND NOT (byte+1==0x02 and byte+2==0x00)  [i.e. not the 1c-02-00 tg_addr]
lengthRules.lengthBitNote: mov_imm generalization: byte+1==0x02 was blanket-excluded to protect the 6-byte `1c 02 00 ..` tg_addr_compute. The mesh OBJECT stage loads a small grid-dim immediate==2 into r5..r9 as `7c 02 | 8c 02 | 9c 02 | 5c 02 | 6c 02` (mesh__mesh_grid3d, uint3(2,2,2)) -- these are 2-byte mov_imm. tg_addr is UNIQUELY byte0==0x1c with byte+2==0x00; a mov_imm with imm==2 is followed by the next op leader (byte+2 != 0x00). Dropped 0x02 from the exclusion and refused only the `.. 02 00` tg_addr signature. mesh_grid3d now tokenizes to 0 leftover; +1 clean file; roundtrip suite ALL PASS. dst=byte0-hi, imm=byte+1 per HW-validated mov_imm (EXP-0031).

lengthRules.applyWhen: TEXTURE companion: byte0 low-3-bits==5 (covers low-nibble 5 sample/gather/read AND 0xd sample_compare) AND (byte+1 & 0xf0)==0x80 AND byte+2==0x0c
lengthRules.lengthBitNote: UNCHANGED length rule (already 14); the DESCRIPTOR match is what was relaxed (see descriptors). Note some texture companions carry byte0 low-nibble 0xd (0x2d/0x3d) or 0x5 with byte+1 low-nibble != 0 -- all length 14.

descriptors.semantics: Texture sample/gather/read/compare/LOD-query bundle: a 4-byte companion (low-nibble 5 sample/gather/read, 0xd compute sample_compare) + a 10-byte sampler op. variant (op+2) selects operation/dimension/LOD-mode; op+2 bit5(0x20)=DEPTH-COMPARE (compareValue CMP sampledDepth; all 8 compareFuncs HW-validated; linear filter => native 2x2 hardware PCF), bit0(0x01)=const texel offset present. companion byte+3 = result descriptor: bit2(0x04)=GATHER, bits[3:5]=gather component r/g/b/a. op+6 = mode (0x10 filtered / 0x00 gather/read/compare / 0x20 LOD-query). tex_slot=op+4 (bit7=index bit), sampler slot + const offset in op+5. LOD/bias/grad and the depth-compare reference are register operands set up by preceding ALU. Same op in compute and fragment; implicit LOD needs a fragment stage.
descriptors.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0016 + EXP-0034): tex_slot/samp_slot (splice flips texture/filter, EXP-0016); sample_compare (op+2 0x20/0x29, companion 0xa0) -- all 8 compareFuncs give the exact shadow pattern, dynamic per-thread ref proves a register operand, LINEAR filter yields fractional PCF (true 2x2 hardware PCF); gather component (companion+3 bits[3:5]) HW-validated r/g/b/a; gather const offset (op+5) HW-validated; LOD-query (op+6=0x20) HW-runs. Remaining op+2 dimension codes and op+3/op+5 offset sub-bits byte-diff-localized (EXP-0016/EXP-0034 mains).

descriptorNotes: tex_sample (low-nibble-5 texture family): (1) match RELAXED on byte+1 from ==0x80 to HIGH-NIBBLE==8 [(8,8,0x80) -> (12,4,8)] so the CHAINED companion forms (byte+1 low-nibble in {2,4,5,6,8,a}, emitted before the 2nd..Nth sample op in a multi-sample kernel) also decode; verified no collision -- no other length-14 descriptor has byte0 low-3-bits==5 with byte+2==0x0c. (2) NEW field `comp_flags` (start 8, width 4) captures the byte+1 low nibble to preserve byte-exact roundtrip. (3) `variant` (op+2) enum EXTENDED with 5 own-MSL-observed codes: 0x05 (2D implicit-LOD sample), 0x33 (sample_compare grad/deriv-LOD), 0x9c (3D read coord-reg), 0xa0 (1D read), 0xd9 (MSAA per-sample read). Result: all 40 corpus texture companions decode, variant-named, roundtrip byte-exact. mov_imm descriptor is UNCHANGED (already matches any high-nibble low-nibble-c, length 2); only its length rule was generalized (see lengthRules).
provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 (field positions from own-MSL byte-diff; texture semantics inherit HW-VALIDATED EXP-0016/EXP-0034; the 5 new variant codes' semantics are inferred from the own-MSL construct that produced them -- NOT HW-spliced). fma-continuation & mov_imm length rules: own-shader clean-tokenization + roundtrip. NO hardware dispatch performed.
